name: themes
description: Backdrop themes for the Claude Code desktop app. The first, bedroom, is a teenager's bedroom in the country at dusk, about 2004, drawn as one SVG with a lighting shader, with things to click (television, VCR, console, computer, lamps) and a /bedroom command.

time.title: Bedroom: time of day
time.description: auto follows the clock; a phase holds that light all day.

sunrise.title: Bedroom: sunrise
sunrise.description: Local time of sunrise, HH:MM from 04:00 to 09:00.

sunset.title: Bedroom: sunset
sunset.description: Local time of sunset, HH:MM from 16:00 to 22:00.

weather.title: Bedroom: weather
weather.description: auto changes by itself every three hours and never picks a storm.

sound.title: Bedroom: sound
sound.description: The television's click, cicadas, rain and thunder. Off by default.

soundPlayer.title: Bedroom: sound player
soundPlayer.description: Empty: found at run time. Else a command line with {file} where the sound file goes.

signal.title: Bedroom: television reacts to Claude
signal.description: The screen flickers while Claude works, and a band rolls down it as the context fills.

hall.title: Bedroom: hallway
hall.description: Now and then someone passes the door, or the hall light comes on.

shader.title: Bedroom: shader
shader.description: Off: the hand-drawn room alone, sent again on every change.
